objects.name: Analytic 1821
objects.description: For iOS, detect Remote Device Management Services by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Cloud Service Enumeration via Application Vetting / Cloud Service Audit [Instrumented app API trace and corresponding cloud-service audit/API telemetry]; User Account Authentication via Application Vetting / Identity Provider Telemetry [App authentication flow instrumentation or IdP sign-in/audit events]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
